rationale: The exact pinned helper fetches issue.body with gh api, extracts detector attributes from the generator marker, builds a local rules_dir/DETECTOR_ID.sh path, and inserts that path inside single quotes in bash -c. The producer documents detector=<id> markers and emits IDs from local detector files. Each individual capture is restricted to a filename-component alphabet that excludes slash, dot, and single quote. This contract covers that component property and its use at the quoted shell/path boundary only; it does not establish an allowlist, validate RUNTIME_AUDIT_RULES_DIR, or establish a security incident.
